user.title: Connect to Amway Atmosphere
user.description:
Please choose one of the following methods to connect your Atmosphere purifier:

⭐ **Recommended: Direct Phone & Password**
Enter your registered phone number and password. The integration emulates the official Healthy Home App to authenticate and obtain permanent tokens automatically.

🔗 **Alternative: Official OAuth Code**
If you prefer manual authorization, sign in at [👉 Amway Official Portal]({auth_url}) and paste the `amwayhealthyhome://loginRedirect?code=...` URL into the code field below.

💡 **Advanced: Direct Access Token**
Paste an existing Access Token or JSON payload directly.
